snippet.title: Abandoned // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/975030/Abandoned/

You wake up in a house, not knowing who or where you are or how you got there. First thing is to try and figure out how to get out. And while doing so...is what you are seeing real? Play to find out.

Developed by
Devious Minds

*Note* This game is no longer available on the Steam store
